text_zh: 人数最少的小队必须阻止所有敌人进入基地。进攻方只要在基地区内存活5秒即可占领基地。守方在全部进攻方被消灭或时间耗尽时获胜。
text_en: The smallest company must prevent all enemies from entering their base.  An attacker can capture the defenders' base by surviving 5 seconds in the base zone.  The defenders win if all attackers are killed or time expires.
text_edited: 人数最少的小队必须阻止所有敌人进入基地。进攻方只要在基地区内存活5秒即可占领基地。守方在全部进攻方被消灭或时间耗尽时获胜。

text_zh: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。
text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.

text_en: Use the Fire Weapon Button to place the claymore in the center of the blast pit.  Aim it toward the target dummies - it will face in the same direction you're facing when you place it.  When the claymore is ready, move to the safety of the blast bunker for detonation.

text_zh: 再按一次开火键将地雷引爆。引爆器在任何距离都有效。定时炸弹没有引爆器--当你离开爆炸范围后它会在设定时间内自动爆炸。如果任务需要用定时炸弹完成目标，任务简报里会说明。
text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button again to detonate the claymore.  The trigger works at any range.  Demolitions charges don't have triggers - they're set to go off on timers after you're clear of the blast area.  If a mission requires a demolitions charge to complete an objective, you'll be told about it in the briefing.

text_zh: 点击开火键能向较近的目标投掷手雷，按住再放开则可以投得更远。注意准星大小不会改变--手雷会落在你投掷的位置，但你要把抛物线的路径计算进去。练习把手雷投过前面的矮墙，或命中远处建筑里的目标。
text_en: Tap the Fire Weapon Button to toss the grenade a short distance, or hold and release the Button for a long throw.  Notice that the reticule doesn't change size - grenades will go exactly where you throw them, but you'll need to learn to take the arc of your throw into account.  Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.

text_zh: 越野训练将教你如何在场景中移动。用左摇杆前后左右移动，用右摇杆转身和调整视角上下。用力推左摇杆即可奔跑。随时按 START 键退出训练。
text_en: The obstacle course will teach you how to move through the world.  Use the left analog stick to move forward and back and side-to-side.  Use the right analog stick to turn, and look up and down.  Press the left analog stick hard to run.  Press the START button at any time to exit training.
text_edited: 越野训练将教你如何在场景中移动。用左摇杆前后左右移动，用右摇杆转身和调整视角上下。用力推左摇杆即可奔跑。随时按 START 键退出训练。

text_en: The route to the next training range is through this darkened hallway.  Switch on your night vision goggles with the Night Vision Button.  Night vision is essential in low-light situations, but you'll see better in full illumination with it switched off.  When you leave the darkened area, press the Night Vision Button again to switch it off.

text_en: When you're standing still you can peek around obstacles.  Press the Left and Right Peek Buttons and practice using the barrier.  Remember, the smaller the target you present to the enemy, the harder for you to get hit.

text_en: In addition to his primary weapon, every soldier can carry one secondary weapon.  You can switch between the primary and secondary by pressing the Change Equipment Button.  Switch to the pistol and practice hitting the short-range targets.

text_en: Notice how the rocket reticule differs from the rifle and grenade reticules.  With rockets you can't fire the weapon until the reticule reaches its minimum size.  Wait for the reticule to converge, then press the Fire Weapon Button.  The standard rocket launcher needs to be reloaded after every shot.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down

text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.
text_edited: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.
text_edited: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_zh: 添加路径点时按住 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键会出现一个射击扇面。用方向键(或左摇杆)可以改变射击扇面的朝向。你可以用它命令战斗小组朝特定方向射击。这适合狙击手或压制火力。
text_en: If you hold the {{BTN:E0B5}} button down while adding a waypoint you’ll see a firing arc. Using the directional buttons (or left analog stick) changes the direction of the firing arc.  You can use this to tell a fireteam to direct their shots in a particular direction.  It’s good for snipers or for laying down cover fire.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down
text_edited: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。

text_zh: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。
text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.
text_edited: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。

text_zh: 用开火键将地雷放置在弹坑中央。把它对准靶子假人--放置时它会朝向你面对的方向。地雷放好后，退到安全的掩体里准备引爆。
text_en: Use the Fire Weapon Button to place the claymore in the center of the blast pit.  Aim it toward the target dummies - it will face in the same direction you're facing when you place it.  When the claymore is ready, move to the safety of the blast bunker for detonation.

text_zh: 再按一次开火键将地雷引爆。引爆器在任何距离都有效。定时炸弹没有引爆器--当你离开爆炸范围后它会在设定时间内自动爆炸。如果任务需要用定时炸弹完成目标，任务简报里会说明。
text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button again to detonate the claymore.  The trigger works at any range.  Demolitions charges don't have triggers - they're set to go off on timers after you're clear of the blast area.  If a mission requires a demolitions charge to complete an objective, you'll be told about it in the briefing.

text_zh: 点击开火键能向较近的目标投掷手雷，按住再放开则可以投得更远。注意准星大小不会改变--手雷会落在你投掷的位置，但你要把抛物线的路径计算进去。练习把手雷投过前面的矮墙，或命中远处建筑里的目标。
text_en: Tap the Fire Weapon Button to toss the grenade a short distance, or hold and release the Button for a long throw.  Notice that the reticule doesn't change size - grenades will go exactly where you throw them, but you'll need to learn to take the arc of your throw into account.  Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.

text_en: The obstacle course will teach you how to move through the world.  Use the left analog stick to move forward and back and side-to-side.  Use the right analog stick to turn, and look up and down.  Press the left analog stick hard to run.  Press the START button at any time to exit training.
text_edited: 越野训练将教你如何在场景中移动。用左摇杆前后左右移动，用右摇杆转身和调整视角上下。用力推左摇杆即可奔跑。随时按 START 键退出训练。

text_en: The route to the next training range is through this darkened hallway.  Switch on your night vision goggles with the Night Vision Button.  Night vision is essential in low-light situations, but you'll see better in full illumination with it switched off.  When you leave the darkened area, press the Night Vision Button again to switch it off.

text_en: When you're standing still you can peek around obstacles.  Press the Left and Right Peek Buttons and practice using the barrier.  Remember, the smaller the target you present to the enemy, the harder for you to get hit.
text_edited: 站立不动时你可以窥视障碍物两侧。按左窥视和右窥视键，利用掩体练习。记住，你暴露给敌人的目标越小，就越难被击中。

text_en: In addition to his primary weapon, every soldier can carry one secondary weapon.  You can switch between the primary and secondary by pressing the Change Equipment Button.  Switch to the pistol and practice hitting the short-range targets.

text_en: Notice how the rocket reticule differs from the rifle and grenade reticules.  With rockets you can't fire the weapon until the reticule reaches its minimum size.  Wait for the reticule to converge, then press the Fire Weapon Button.  The standard rocket launcher needs to be reloaded after every shot.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_en: If you hold the {{BTN:E0B5}} button down while adding a waypoint you’ll see a firing arc. Using the directional buttons (or left analog stick) changes the direction of the firing arc.  You can use this to tell a fireteam to direct their shots in a particular direction.  It’s good for snipers or for laying down cover fire.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down
text_edited: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。

text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire. Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.

text_en: The obstacle course will teach you how to move through the world.  Use the left analog stick to move forward and back and side-to-side.  Use the right analog stick to turn, and look up and down.  Press the left analog stick hard to run.  Press the START button at any time to exit training.

text_en: The route to the next training range is through this darkened hallway.  Switch on your night vision goggles with the Night Vision Button.  Night vision is essential in low-light situations, but you'll see better in full illumination with it switched off.  When you leave the darkened area, press the Night Vision Button again to switch it off.

text_en: When you're standing still you can peek around obstacles.  Press the Left and Right Peek Buttons and practice using the barrier.  Remember, the smaller the target you present to the enemy, the harder for you to get hit.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down
text_edited: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。

text_zh: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。
text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.
text_edited: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。

text_en: Use the Fire Weapon Button to place the claymore in the center of the blast pit.  Aim it toward the target dummies - it will face in the same direction you're facing when you place it.  When the claymore is ready, move to the safety of the blast bunker for detonation.

text_zh: 再按一次开火键将地雷引爆。引爆器在任何距离都有效。定时炸弹没有引爆器--当你离开爆炸范围后它会在设定时间内自动爆炸。如果任务需要用定时炸弹完成目标，任务简报里会说明。
text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button again to detonate the claymore.  The trigger works at any range.  Demolitions charges don't have triggers - they're set to go off on timers after you're clear of the blast area.  If a mission requires a demolitions charge to complete an objective, you'll be told about it in the briefing.

text_zh: 点击开火键能向较近的目标投掷手雷，按住再放开则可以投得更远。注意准星大小不会改变--手雷会落在你投掷的位置，但你要把抛物线的路径计算进去。练习把手雷投过前面的矮墙，或命中远处建筑里的目标。
text_en: Tap the Fire Weapon Button to toss the grenade a short distance, or hold and release the Button for a long throw.  Notice that the reticule doesn't change size - grenades will go exactly where you throw them, but you'll need to learn to take the arc of your throw into account.  Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.

text_en: The obstacle course will teach you how to move through the world.  Use the left analog stick to move forward and back and side-to-side.  Use the right analog stick to turn, and look up and down.  Press the left analog stick hard to run.  Press the START button at any time to exit training.

text_zh: 通往下一个训练区的路要穿过这条黑暗的走廊。按夜视镜键打开夜视仪。夜视仪在光线昏暗时必不可少，但在光线充足的地方关掉它看得更清楚。离开黑暗区域后，再按一次夜视镜键将其关闭。
text_en: The route to the next training range is through this darkened hallway.  Switch on your night vision goggles with the Night Vision Button.  Night vision is essential in low-light situations, but you'll see better in full illumination with it switched off.  When you leave the darkened area, press the Night Vision Button again to switch it off.

text_en: When you're standing still you can peek around obstacles.  Press the Left and Right Peek Buttons and practice using the barrier.  Remember, the smaller the target you present to the enemy, the harder for you to get hit.

text_en: In addition to his primary weapon, every soldier can carry one secondary weapon.  You can switch between the primary and secondary by pressing the Change Equipment Button.  Switch to the pistol and practice hitting the short-range targets.

text_en: Notice how the rocket reticule differs from the rifle and grenade reticules.  With rockets you can't fire the weapon until the reticule reaches its minimum size.  Wait for the reticule to converge, then press the Fire Weapon Button.  The standard rocket launcher needs to be reloaded after every shot.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.
text_edited: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_en: If you hold the {{BTN:E0B5}} button down while adding a waypoint you’ll see a firing arc. Using the directional buttons (or left analog stick) changes the direction of the firing arc.  You can use this to tell a fireteam to direct their shots in a particular direction.  It’s good for snipers or for laying down cover fire.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down
text_edited: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。

text_zh: 突击步枪是你的主要武器。瞄准目标然后按下开火键即可射击。注意你在移动和射击时准星的变化。准星越小射击就越精确。对下面的靶子练习一下射击。如果没有子弹了，按换子弹键更换弹夹。
text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.

text_en: Use the Fire Weapon Button to place the claymore in the center of the blast pit.  Aim it toward the target dummies - it will face in the same direction you're facing when you place it.  When the claymore is ready, move to the safety of the blast bunker for detonation.

text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button again to detonate the claymore.  The trigger works at any range.  Demolitions charges don't have triggers - they're set to go off on timers after you're clear of the blast area.  If a mission requires a demolitions charge to complete an objective, you'll be told about it in the briefing.

Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.

text_en: In addition to his primary weapon, every soldier can carry one secondary weapon.  You can switch between the primary and secondary by pressing the Change Equipment Button.  Switch to the pistol and practice hitting the short-range targets.

text_zh: 你应该注意到火箭筒的准星和步枪与手雷的都不一样。你必须要等准星变成最小的时候才能开火。等准星收缩到最小后再按开火键。标准的火箭发射器每发射一枚就要装一次弹。
text_en: Notice how the rocket reticule differs from the rifle and grenade reticules.  With rockets you can't fire the weapon until the reticule reaches its minimum size.  Wait for the reticule to converge, then press the Fire Weapon Button.  The standard rocket launcher needs to be reloaded after every shot.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_zh: 添加路径点时按住 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键会出现一个射击扇面。用方向键(或左摇杆)可以改变射击扇面的朝向。你可以用它命令战斗小组朝特定方向射击。这适合狙击手或压制火力。
text_en: If you hold the {{BTN:E0B5}} button down while adding a waypoint you’ll see a firing arc. Using the directional buttons (or left analog stick) changes the direction of the firing arc.  You can use this to tell a fireteam to direct their shots in a particular direction.  It’s good for snipers or for laying down cover fire.

text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down

text_en: The assault rifle is your primary infantry weapon.  Aim at a target and press the Fire Weapon Button to shoot.  Notice how the reticule changes size as you move and fire.  The smaller the reticule, the more accurate your shot will be.  Practice hitting the targets downrange.  If you run out of bullets, change magazines with the Reload Weapon Button.

text_en: Use the Fire Weapon Button to place the claymore in the center of the blast pit.  Aim it toward the target dummies - it will face in the same direction you're facing when you place it.  When the claymore is ready, move to the safety of the blast bunker for detonation.

text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button again to detonate the claymore.  The trigger works at any range.  Demolitions charges don't have triggers - they're set to go off on timers after you're clear of the blast area.  If a mission requires a demolitions charge to complete an objective, you'll be told about it in the briefing.

text_zh: 点击开火键能向较近的目标投掷手雷，按住再放开则可以投得更远。注意准星大小不会改变--手雷会落在你投掷的位置，但你要把抛物线的路径计算进去。练习把手雷投过前面的矮墙，或命中远处建筑里的目标。
text_en: Tap the Fire Weapon Button to toss the grenade a short distance, or hold and release the Button for a long throw.  Notice that the reticule doesn't change size - grenades will go exactly where you throw them, but you'll need to learn to take the arc of your throw into account.  Practice lobbing grenades over the low wall in front of you, or hitting the targets in the far building.
text_edited: 点击开火键能向较近的目标投掷手雷，按住再放开则可以投得更远。注意准星大小不会改变--手雷会落在你投掷的位置，但你要把抛物线的路径计算进去。练习把手雷投过前面的矮墙，或命中远处建筑里的目标。

text_en: Press the Fire Weapon Button to fire the machine gun.  Notice that you don't have a targeting reticule - use the tracers to walk your shots onto the target.  Practice shooting at the targets downrange.  When you're done firing, press the Perform Action Button to quit.

text_en: The obstacle course will teach you how to move through the world.  Use the left analog stick to move forward and back and side-to-side.  Use the right analog stick to turn, and look up and down.  Press the left analog stick hard to run.  Press the START button at any time to exit training.
text_edited: 越野训练将教你如何在场景中移动。用左摇杆前后左右移动，用右摇杆转身和调整视角上下。用力推左摇杆即可奔跑。随时按 START 键退出训练。

text_en: The route to the next training range is through this darkened hallway.  Switch on your night vision goggles with the Night Vision Button.  Night vision is essential in low-light situations, but you'll see better in full illumination with it switched off.  When you leave the darkened area, press the Night Vision Button again to switch it off.

text_en: When you're standing still you can peek around obstacles.  Press the Left and Right Peek Buttons and practice using the barrier.  Remember, the smaller the target you present to the enemy, the harder for you to get hit.

text_en: In addition to his primary weapon, every soldier can carry one secondary weapon.  You can switch between the primary and secondary by pressing the Change Equipment Button.  Switch to the pistol and practice hitting the short-range targets.

text_en: Notice how the rocket reticule differs from the rifle and grenade reticules.  With rockets you can't fire the weapon until the reticule reaches its minimum size.  Wait for the reticule to converge, then press the Fire Weapon Button.  The standard rocket launcher needs to be reloaded after every shot.

text_en: This is the rocket range.  Here you'll learn how to fire antitank rockets. Press the START button at any time to exit training.

text_zh: 摧毁坦克和其它装甲车辆的唯一办法就是使用反坦克火箭筒--如果任务简报里提到要对付装甲车，别忘了给你的队员装备上火箭筒。同时要记住火箭筒的尾部也会爆炸--如果你开火时身后有队友，他们也会被烧伤。
text_en: The only way to destroy a tank or other armored vehicle is with an antitank rocket - so be sure to equip your team with them if the mission briefing indicates you're going up against armor.  And remember that rockets have a backblast - if you fire a rocket when there are friendlies standing behind you, you'll take them out as well.

text_en: The sniper rifle is equipped with a scope for long-range shots.  Use the Zoom In/Out buttons for continuous zoom control.  Practice hitting the long-range targets.

text_zh: 除了站立，你还可以蹲下和卧倒。在战场上，压低身体是避免中弹的好办法，卧倒时你的射击也会更精确。用站起和蹲下键练习更换姿势。卧倒并从铁丝网下面爬过去。
text_en: In addition to standing upright, you can crouch and go prone.  When you're on the battlefield, keeping your head down is a good way to avoid getting shot, and your own shots will be more accurate if you're lying down.  Practice changing your stance using the Stance Up and Stance Down Buttons.  Go prone and crawl under the barbed wire.

text_zh: 你的小队分为两个战斗小组。你在A组。在指挥地图界面选中一个战斗小组并在地图上放置路径点，就可以命令它移动。按 {{BTN:E0B5}} 键添加路径点，按 {{BTN:E0B1}} 键删除。练习给B组下达移动命令。进出指挥地图界面观察他们执行你的命令。
text_en: Your platoon is organized into two fireteams.  You're in Fireteam Alpha.  You can tell a fireteam where to move by selecting it in the command map interface and placing waypoints on the map.  Use the {{BTN:E0B5}} button to add a waypoint, and press the {{BTN:E0B1}} button  to remove it.  Practice giving movement orders to Fireteam Bravo.  Switch in and out of the command map interface to watch them follow your orders.

text_en: If you hold the {{BTN:E0B5}} button down while adding a waypoint you’ll see a firing arc. Using the directional buttons (or left analog stick) changes the direction of the firing arc. text_zh: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。
text_en: The Command interface determines each fireteam's rules of engagement or ROE.  Using the movement ROE you can order a fireteam to Hold, Advance, or Advance At All Costs.  Fireteams will automatically switch from Advance to Hold if they're in danger.  If you want them to keep moving no matter what, set them to Advance At All Costs.  Practice changing the movement ROE for your fireteams.
text_edited: 指挥界面决定每个战斗小组的交战规则。用移动交战规则你可以命令战斗小组待命，前进或不惜一切代价前进。战斗小组遇到危险时会自动从前进切换为待命。如果你想让他们不顾一切继续推进，就设为不惜一切代价前进。练习改变你战斗小组的移动交战规则。

text_zh: 战斗交战规则用来设定每个战斗小组的攻击性。侦察的攻击性最低--战斗小组会尽量避免与敌军交战，但遭到攻击时也会还击。突击是默认状态--战斗小组会向他们看到的敌人发动进攻。压制最为激进--战斗小组会朝敌人方向进行压制火力射击，尽量压住敌人。
text_en: The combat ROE is used to set the aggression level of each fireteam.  Recon means the fireteam will try to avoid contact with the enemy, but will return fire if attacked.  Assault is the default - the fireteam will engage any targets they see.  Suppress is the most aggressive - the fireteam will lay down cover fire in the general direction of the enemy and try to keep them pinned down

text_zh:
地点：南奥塞梯自治区

欢迎来到提比里斯，先生们。希望你们在飞机上休息过了，因为到了这里，我们要干的活还很多。

情况是这样的：我们应格鲁吉亚政府的要求前来，协助他们对付俄罗斯边境上的叛军。我们的行动区域是南奥塞梯自治区，一片遍布小村庄和荒野的山区。奥塞提人和格鲁吉亚军多年小规模冲突不断，但近来攻击已经升级到全面战争的边缘。华盛顿方面认为，俄罗斯人在背后操纵了这次冲突，想以此为借口介入并占领整个地区。我们的任务，就是赶在这之前从根基上除掉这场叛乱。

第一项任务是袭击高加索山区的一处叛军基地。叛军头目帕博施维里一直在袭击塔雷克河沿岸的军方车队。你们要先端掉他的哨所，再打他的主营地。帕博施维里就在山顶的山洞里，那里是他的指挥中心。可以的话就活捉他。但记住，不消灭他所有的警卫，他是不会投降的。
text_en:
Location: South Ossetian Autonomous Region

Welcome to Tbilisi, gentlemen - I hope you got some shuteye on the flight from Bragg, because now that we're here we've got a lot of work to do.

Here's the situation: We've been deployed at the request of the Georgian government to help them deal with rebels on their Russian border.  Our area of operations will be the South Ossetian Autonomous region - 1500 square miles of small villages and rugged backcountry.  The Ossetians have been skirmishing with the Georgian army for years, but lately the attacks have escalated to the verge of all-out war.  Washington thinks that the Russians have engineered the current flare-up as an excuse to step in and annex the whole region.  Our job is to cut the legs out from under the revolution before that can happen.

Our first mission is a raid on a rebel base in the Caucasus Mountains.  A rebel leader named Bakur Papashvili has been attacking army convoys across the Terek River.  You'll need to take out his guard posts first, then hit his main camp.  You'll find Papashvili in the caves at the top of the hill where he's set up a command center.  Take him alive if you can, but remember that he won't surrender unless all his guards are eliminated.

地点：南奥塞梯自治区

我们这次的任务是搜救。海军一直从黑海的航母战斗群出动战机，打击叛军阵地。昨晚敌人运气不错，用一枚防空导弹击落了我们一架F-18。飞行员和武器官都在坠机前弹射逃生，可刚打开求救信号就被叛军抓走了。

他们被关在坠机点附近的一座农场里，等着被审问。你们的任务就是打进去，把他们活着带出来。侦察照片显示，那架F-18大体完好，但守卫森严。如果可能，安放炸药把飞机炸掉。不过别为此冒险，主任务要紧。

另外，尽量减少奥塞提人的伤亡。俄罗斯人已经在联合国拿我们在这里这件事大做文章，我们不能再给他们送把柄。要是莫斯科决定介入，我们就会发现自己正处在一场大规模战争的正中央。
text_en:
Location: South Ossetian Autonomous Region

We've been tapped for a search and rescue.  The Navy's been flying sorties against rebel positions from its carrier battle group in the Black Sea.  Last night, the bad guys got lucky with a SAM and took out one of our F-18s.  The pilot and the weapons officer both bailed out before impact, but the rebels picked them up shortly after they activated their beacons. 

They're being held for interrogation at a farm near the crash site.  Your job is to go in and bring them back out alive.  Recon photos show the F-18 is still largely intact but heavily guarded.  If it's possible to plant a demo charge and blow the plane, do it - but don't jeopardize your main mission. 

And try to minimize Ossetian casualties - the Russians are already making a big stink at the U.N. about us being here and we don't want to give them any more ammunition.  If Moscow decides to intervene, we're going to find ourselves smack in the middle of a major war.

地点：南奥塞梯自治区

总部刚刚传来消息，先生们。官方已经确认，今晨六点，三个俄罗斯装甲师越过边境，与北面的叛军会合。俄罗斯外交部长发表声明，指责别国干涉地区事务。看来我们摊上了一场全面的国际事件。

目前美国仍然支持格鲁吉亚合法政府。我们的命令是，原话：以一切可行的方式协助格鲁吉亚军的防御作战。说得直白些，就是我们拿到了炸毁目标的许可。

首要任务，是拖住开往提比里斯的装甲主力纵队。我们在这以西约60公里处找到了一个伏击点，那里公路从一条铁路下方穿过。附近有一处格鲁吉亚指挥所，一旦被端掉，他们的整个西翼就会崩溃。先消灭俄军先头巡逻队，再打坦克。还有，让你们的爆破手留在掩体里，直到用得上他为止。想拦停那些坦克，非得往排气管里塞一发火箭弹不可。
text_en:
Location: South Ossetian Autonomous Region

Word just came down from HQ, gentlemen.  We have official confirmation that at 0600 hours three Russian armored divisions crossed the border and linked up with the rebel forces in the north.  The Russian foreign minister has issued a statement condemning "international meddling in regional affairs".  Looks like we've got ourselves a full-scale international incident.

For now the U.S. is still backing the legitimate Georgian government.  Our orders are, quote, "to aid the Georgian army's defensive operations in any way practical".  Short and sweet that means we've got the green light to blow stuff up.

First priority is to slow down the main armored column headed for Tbilisi.  We've identified an ambush point about 60 klicks west of here where the highway crosses under a rail line.  A Georgian command post is nearby - if it's overrun their entire western flank will collapse.  Take out the Russian advance patrols first, then the tanks.  And keep your demolitions expert under cover until you need him - those tanks aren't going to be stopped by anything less than a rocket up the tailpipe.

地点：格鲁吉亚共和国

格鲁吉亚人暂时挡住了俄国人，但他们撑不了太久。总统和内阁已经逃离本国，去建立流亡政府了。我们在那里只待到把其余的人安全撤出为止。

总部刚接到无线电呼叫，阿赫梅塔村附近有两个英国人。他们的车辆坏了，被隔断在格鲁吉亚防线之外。我们派你们乘直升机进去，为他们打开一条撤退路线。动作要快：在他们最后的通话里，他们说自己可能已经被一支俄军巡逻队发现了。
text_en:
Location: Republic of Georgia

The Georgians have stopped the Russians temporarily, but they're not going to hold out for long.  The president and his cabinet have already fled the country to set up a government-in-exile.  We're in country only for as long as it takes to get the rest of our people out safely.

HQ just got a radio call from a couple of Brits up near the village of Ahmeta.  Their transportation broke down and they're cut off from the Georgian lines.  We're sending you in by chopper to open up an escape route for them.  You'll need to move fast - in their last message they said they thought they'd been spotted by a Russian patrol.

路上有件事要你们顺路查一下。上一班任务里，俄国人用便携式防空导弹击落了我们一架海鹰，坠毁在你们以北的一座公园里。机组没有任何音讯，没有人声，也没有信标，多半没有生还者。但你们的命令是查清残骸，确认到底。

小心俄军巡逻队。也要当心格鲁吉亚平民：街上到处是难民，附带伤亡要压到最低。
text_en:
Location: Tbilisi, Republic of Georgia

Time to get the hell out of Dodge - intel says Russian troops have reached the city limits.  The rest of our people have already been evac'ed - you gentlemen are the absolute tip of the Dachshund's tail.  The Navy is running a shuttle between our embassy and the U.S.S. Ronald Reagan out in the Black Sea.  Two hours from now the last Seahawk will leave the embassy's roof - you'd better be on it.

On the way there there's one thing we want you to check out.  The Russians brought down one of our Seahawks on the last run - hit it with a man-portable SAM before it reached the embassy.  It crashed in a park just north of your position.  We haven't received any communication from the crew - no voice, no beacon - probably there are no survivors.  But your orders are to check out the wreckage and make sure.

Be on the look out for Russian patrols.  And watch out for Georgian civilians as well - there are plenty of refugees in the streets and we want to keep collateral damage to a minimum.

地点：俄罗斯，伊兹博尔斯克

正式消息：阿尔巴托夫总统刚刚公开宣布，欢迎格鲁吉亚共和国加入新的俄罗斯民主联盟。当然，没人承认这次吞并。格鲁吉亚流亡政府在日内瓦强烈否认，美英德三国也公开谴责了俄国入侵。但说再多，也撼动不了提比里斯城外的那些坦克。

大人物们确信，阿尔巴托夫和他的将军们又在策划下一次行动。卫星发现波罗的海沿岸、拉脱维亚边境附近有大规模部队调动。拉脱维亚、立陶宛和爱沙尼亚都曾是旧苏联的一部分，把它们重新纳入莫斯科的控制，是极端民族主义者多年的目标。

我们派你们去收集这次进攻的情报。俄军在伊兹博尔斯克设立了一处指挥所，那是边境几英里外的一座中世纪古堡。你们的任务是渗透进去，取回所有记载俄军作战计划的文件。当心巡逻队，沿路部队调动频繁。城堡里还有一个通讯站，别让守军呼叫支援，否则你们就要面对一场恶战。

最后一件事。附近有一处机动防空导弹阵地。先侦察，如果守备松懈，就用火箭弹把它端掉。
text_en:
Location: Izborsk, Russia

It's official - President Arbatov just appeared, "welcoming" the Republic of Georgia into the new Russian Democratic Union.  Of course, no one's recognizing the annexation - the Georgian government-in-exile issued a strong denial from their offices in Geneva, and the U.S., Great Britain, and Germany have all publicly condemned the Russian invasion - but all the talk in the world isn't going to budge those tanks in Tblisi. 

The big boys are convinced that Arbatov and his generals are engineering another "intervention".  Satellites have detected major troop movements on the Baltic coast, near the Latvian border.  Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia were all part of the old Soviet empire and bringing them back under Moscow's control has been part of the Ultranationalist agenda for years. 

We're sending you in to gather intelligence about the coming attack.  The Russians have set up a command post at Izborsk, an old medieval fortress a few miles from the border.  Your mission is to infiltrate the post and recover any documents describing the Russian battle plans.  Watch out for patrols - there's been a lot of troop movement along the road.  There's also a comm station inside the castle - don't let the garrison radio for help, or you'll have a major firefight on your hands. 

One final twist.  There's a mobile SAM site nearby.  Reconnoiter, and if it's lightly guarded, take it out with rockets.

text_en:
Location: Lubana River, Latvia

Bad news.  The Russians went on the offensive in the Baltics this morning, three days ahead of schedule.  Satellite images show two main thrusts - one along the coast to Tallinn and the other straight past Izborsk to Riga.  Senior command is trying to field a defensive force from our bases in Germany, but they need more time.  And, we're the ones who are going to provide it. 

Your mission is to blow the bridge where the Riga highway crosses the Lubana River.  This will seriously damage the enemy's ability to bring forward reinforcements and will slow their advance dramatically.  Plant demo charges on both of the main pillars of the bridge, then clear out to the extraction zone.  Don't try to engage the primary force guarding the bridge - they'll eat you for lunch.  But use your own judgement on the Russian camp near the river.  If it's lightly guarded, take it out - it'll only add to the disruption.

你们的任务是炸毁里加公路横跨卢巴纳河的那座桥。这会严重破坏敌军向前方运送增援的能力，大大拖慢他们的推进。在桥的两根主桥塔上安放炸药，然后撤到撤离区。别去硬碰守桥的主力部队，那等于送死。至于河边那个俄军营地，你们自己判断。守备松懈就顺手端掉，能让敌人更乱。

text_zh:
地点：立陶宛，文塔

第一装甲师总算挡住了俄军的推进，但也只是勉强。我们的增援正从海岸北上，可明天才能赶到。眼下局势瞬息万变，如果俄军抢在我们准备好之前再次进攻，这条防线能不能守住很难说。

俄军在这一地区的主力，集结在一座叫文塔的立陶宛小村庄附近。他们在附近山丘上架设了机动火炮，正炮击我们的阵地。你们的任务是打进去，端掉那些火炮。

直升机把你们投放在镇西一座废弃农场。你们一到就很可能暴露，所以要迅速建立防御圈，否则会被冲垮。就位之后，总部会沿主路发动进攻。守住农场，直到看见我们的坦克，然后与他们会合，一起推进进村。清空村庄，再向山丘上的炮兵阵地前进。每人一发反坦克火箭弹应该就够了。
text_en:
Location: Venta, Lithuania

1st Armored Division has managed to stop the Russian advance... but just barely.  We've got reinforcements coming up from the coast, but they won't be here until tomorrow.  Right now, the situation is very fluid - if the Russians resume the attack before we're ready, we're not sure our line will hold.  

The main concentration of Russian troops in this sector is near a little Lithuanian village named Venta.  They've set up mobile artillery in the hills nearby and are using it to shell our position here.  Your mission is to go in and take out that artillery.

The chopper will drop you at an abandoned farm just west of town.  It's unlikely that your arrival will go undetected, so you'll need to establish a defensive perimeter quick or you'll be overrun.  Once you're in place HQ will launch an attack down the main road.  Hold the farm until you see our tanks, then link up with them and proceed into the village.  Clear out the village, then proceed to the artillery batteries in the hills.  One antitank rocket apiece should do the job.

text_zh:
地点：拉脱维亚，内雷塔沼泽

俄军目前在里加以南陷入停滞。第一装甲师已经做好大规模进攻的准备，只等天气放晴。我们派你们现在就潜入俄军战线后方，赶在进攻开始前破坏他们的通讯。

你们的目标是立陶宛与拉脱维亚边境上的一处俄军监听站。他们把设备架在沼泽中央，所以你们免不了要蹚水。这片沼泽有三座主要岛屿，都需要清空。我们认为监听站本身在东岛上，但你们要把三座岛都搜一遍才保险。可能的话，尽量活捉指挥官，他也许掌握着俄军防御部署的重要情报。
text_en:
Location: Nereta Swamp, Latvia

The Russians are stalled just south of Riga.  1st Armored is prepped to launch a major offensive as soon as the weather clears.  We're sending you in now behind the Russian lines to disrupt communications before the attack.

Your target is a Russian listening post on the border between Lithuania and Latvia.  They've set up their equipment in the middle of a swamp so you're going to have to get your feet wet.  There are three main islands you'll need to clear.  We think the listening post itself is on the eastern island, but we want you to sweep all three to be certain.  Try to capture the commanding officer alive if possible - he might have valuable information about the Russian defensive strategy.

地点：立陶宛，维尔纽斯

好消息。第一装甲师在乌特纳和雷泽克内取得大胜，俄军正在全线后撤。再推一把，就能把他们永远赶出波罗的海。据说俄军高层对这场败仗非常难堪，正在把责任推给阿尔巴托夫总统和其他领导人，一场政变可能正在酝酿。

我们派你们进入立陶宛首都维尔纽斯。俄军从入侵第一周起就占据着这里，立陶宛地下抵抗组织也在这里有过不少大动作，整座城市几乎成了废墟。你们将护送一支坦克纵队进入老城中心，收复总统府残存的部分和其他要点。就像俄国人在格罗兹尼学到的那样，没有步兵配合就把装甲开进城区等于自杀。残存的俄军已经背靠绝境，不会轻易认输。当心废墟里的狙击手和反坦克火箭。还有，一如既往，尽量减少平民伤亡。
text_en:
Location: Vilnius, Lithuania

Good news.  1st Armored won major victories at Utena and Rezekne, and the Russians are falling back on all fronts.  One final push and they'll be out of the Baltics for good.  Word is the Russian military brass is taking the defeat hard.  They're blaming President Arbatov and the other political leaders - there just might be a coup brewing.

We're sending you into Vilnius, the Lithuanian capital.  The Russians have held it since the first week of the invasion and it's been the site of some significant action by the Lithuanian underground - the place is practically in ruins.  You'll be escorting a tank column into the heart of the old city to liberate what's left of the presidential palace and some other key locations.  As the Russians learned in Grozny, sending armor into an urban setting without proper infantry support is suicide.  The remaining Russian troops have their backs to the wall so they're not going to go down without a fight.  Watch out for snipers and antitank rockets fired from the shelter of the ruins.  And, as always, try to keep civilian casualties to a minimum.

text_zh:
地点：俄罗斯，利亚第

昨天下午，最后一批敌军撤过了拉脱维亚边境。公众对极端民族主义者的支持一落千丈，甚至有传言说军方已经把阿尔巴托夫总统软禁了起来。俄罗斯的局势眼看就要失控。

下一项任务是一次简单的营救。十天前，两名美军士兵的悍马车在卢扎附近遭伏击，两人被俘，目前关在俄罗斯境内的一座战俘营。按惯例华盛顿会等战争结束再谈交换，但他们当中有一位是议员的儿子。你们的任务就是打进去，把他们活着带出来。

警戒很严：营地外围有探照灯，里面守卫装备精良。别想着强攻进去，那绝无可能。用消音武器悄悄进去，端掉哨所，找到士兵，然后撤离。

另外，到了那里还要留意另一名囚犯，他叫莫罗希金。据说他被关在医务室。总部说他是重要的异见人士，救出他会给莫斯科的极端民族主义者添更多麻烦。
text_en:
Location: Ljady, Russia

The last enemy units pulled back across the Latvian border sometime yesterday afternoon.  Public support for the Ultranationalists has dropped like a rock, and there are rumors that the military has President Arbatov under house arrest. It looks like things in Russia are turning ugly fast.

Your next mission is a simple rescue.  Ten days ago two U.S. soldiers were taken prisoner when their humvee was ambushed near Ludza.  They're currently being held at a POW camp in Russia.  Normally Washington would let them sit out the duration, but one of them is a senator's son.  Your job is to go in and bring them out alive.

Security is tight - searchlights around the perimeter, well-armed guards inside.  Don't try to shoot your way in - you'll never make it.  Go in quiet with silenced weapons, secure the guard post, locate the soldiers, and get out.

And, while you're there, be on the lookout for one other prisoner, a guy named Moroshkin.  Supposedly he's being held in the infirmary.  HQ says that he's some kind of major dissident and that springing him would make more trouble for the Ultranationalists in Moscow.

text_zh:
地点：俄罗斯，摩尔曼斯克

俄罗斯正在崩溃。就我们所知，阿尔巴托夫已经死了，被军方当作波罗的海惨败的替罪羊处决了。全国大部分地区戒严，士兵在街头巡逻，主要城市实行宵禁。极端民族主义者在军中到底还有多少支持并不清楚，到处都有士兵拒绝向平民开枪、甚至拒绝离开营房的报告。

我们的目标是削弱政变领导者的支持基础，为此要对支持极端民族主义者的关键军事基地发起一连串隐蔽袭击。你们的第一个目标是摩尔曼斯克海军基地，那是他们北方舰队的司令部，也是潜艇部队的重要作战中心。带上爆破手，炸掉潜艇库和其他看起来有价值的目标。动作要快，警报一响，基地警卫就会蜂拥而至。

祝好运，你们会用得上的。
text_en:
Location: Murmansk, Russia

Russia is falling apart.  Arbatov is dead, as far as we can tell - executed by the military as a scapegoat for the fiasco in the Baltic.  Most of the country is under martial law, with soldiers patrolling the streets and curfews enforced in the major cities.  It's unclear how much support the Ultranationalists really have in the military - there are widespread reports of soldiers refusing to fire on civilians, or even to leave their barracks. 

Our goal is to whittle down the base of support for the leaders of the coup.  As a result, we're launching a series of covert raids against key military bases that are backing the Ultranationalists.  Your first target is the naval base at Murmansk - it's the headquarters of their northern fleet and a major operations center for their submarine service.  Take a demolitions expert, and blow the sub pens and any other targets that appear promising.  You'll have to move quick - once the alarm is raised, base security will be all over you. 

Good luck, you're going to need it.

text_zh:
地点：俄罗斯，阿尔汉格尔斯克

看起来内战爆发了。政府和军方的中间派已经联合起来，共同对抗极端民族主义者。从斯摩棱斯克到符拉迪沃斯托克，到处都有俄罗斯人打俄罗斯人的报告。

我们继续对支持政变的军事基地发动袭击。下一个目标是阿尔汉格尔斯克空军基地。那里是两架机型的试飞场：S-37金雕，一种新型试验战斗机；以及KA-50短吻鳄，俄罗斯下一代攻击直升机。你们的任务是在这两种机的机库里安放炸药，并彻底瘫痪控制塔的运作。

情报显示，阿尔汉格尔斯克的守备很松，政变后逃兵数量急剧增加。所以不必讲究潜入技巧。根据我们的分析，最好的打法就是正面强攻。狠狠地打，快进快出。
text_en:
Location: Arkhangel'sk, Russia

It looks like civil war.  The Centrists in the government and military have formed an alliance against the Ultranationalists.  We're getting reports of Russian-on-Russian fighting from Smolensk to Vladivostok.

We're continuing our strategy of raids against military bases that are backing the coup.  Your next target is the air base at Arkhangel'sk.  It's the test site for both  the S-37 "Berkut", a new experimental fighter prototype, and the Ka-50 "Hokum", Russia's next generation attack helicopter.  Your objectives are to plant demo charges in both the "Berkut" and "Hokum" hangars as well as completely shutting down operations in the control tower.

Intel indicates that security at Arkhangel'sk is light - apparently there's been a sharp increase in the number of desertions since the coup - so don't worry about trying to finesse your way in.  Based on our analysis the best approach is a direct frontal assault.  Hit them hard and fast and get out as quickly as possible.

text_zh:
地点：俄罗斯，托罗佩克

早期战报显示，中间派部队与极端民族主义者的战斗陷入僵持。公众对极端民族主义者的支持几乎消散殆尽，处决总统让他们彻底失去了合法性，但他们仍掌握着相当一部分军队。代理总理卡尔平已私下请求北约出兵，帮助忠诚的俄军平定政变。

第一装甲师已经越过拉脱维亚边境，正在向莫斯科推进。卫星图像显示，极端民族主义主力正在托罗佩克附近集结，距我们当前位置以东约200公里。你们的任务是与他们会合，并担任进攻先锋。预计抵抗会极其顽强：装甲部队、特种部队，应有尽有。你们必须拿下穿越山地的两条通道，并挡住俄军的一切反扑。只要在这里实现突破，政变就完蛋了。
text_en:
Location: Toropec, Russia

Early reports indicate that the Centrist forces are stalled in their fight with the Ultranationalists.  Popular support for the Ultranationalists has withered away to practically nothing - they lost all legitimacy when they executed the president - but they still control a sizable chunk of the military.  Acting Prime Minister Karpin has privately requested a NATO force to help the loyal Russian troops crush the coup.

1st Armored Division has already crossed the Latvian border and is headed for Moscow.  Satellite images show the main Ultranationalist force massing near Toropec, about 200 klicks east of our current position.  Your mission is to link up with them and spearhead the assault.  Expect extremely heavy resistance - armor, Spetznaz, the works.  You'll need to take both passes through the mountains and hold them against all Russian counterattacks.  But if we achieve a breakthrough here, the coup is finished.
text_edited:
地点：俄罗斯，托罗佩克

早期战报显示，中间派部队与极端民族主义者的战斗陷入僵持。公众对极端民族主义者的支持几乎消散殆尽，处决总统让他们彻底失去了合法性，但他们仍掌握着相当一部分军队。代理总理卡尔平已私下请求北约出兵，帮助忠诚的俄军平定政变。

第一装甲师已经越过拉脱维亚边境，正在向莫斯科推进。卫星图像显示，极端民族主义主力正在托罗佩克附近集结，距我们当前位置以东约200公里。你们的任务是与他们会合，并担任进攻先锋。预计抵抗会极其顽强：装甲部队、特种部队，应有尽有。你们必须拿下穿越山地的两条通道，并挡住俄军的一切反扑。只要在这里实现突破，政变就完蛋了。

text_zh:
地点：俄罗斯，莫斯科

我从未想过，有朝一日美军会代表俄罗斯人民在红场作战。这是最后的决战，先生们。极端民族主义者手里只剩克里姆林宫和周边不多的地盘。我们要在这里了结这一切。

第一件事：你们当前位置以东不远处，有一小队美军被困。穿过老城区，消灭沿途的一切抵抗，把他们救出来。然后向南穿过古姆百货大楼，抵达红场。街上会挤满难民，注意控制火力。记住，我们是解放者，不是征服者。

红场防守严密，要有面对装甲部队的准备。那里几乎没有掩体，但幸好积雪会降低能见度，给你们带来优势。

现在出发，去干你们的活。赢下这一仗，然后回家。
text_en:
Location: Moscow, Russia

I never thought I'd see U.S. troops fighting in Red Square on behalf of the Russian people.  This is the final showdown, gentlemen.  The Ultranationalists hold the Kremlin and not much else.  We're going to finish this thing right here.

First order of business is a squad of U.S. troops pinned down just to the east of your current position.  Make your way through the medieval quarter, eliminate any resistance you encounter, and relieve those GI's.  From there head south through the GUM department store to get to Red Square.  The street will be full of refugees so watch your fire - remember that we're here as liberators, not as conquerors.

Red Square is heavily defended.  Be prepared for armor.  There's almost no cover, but fortunately the snow should cut visibility and give you an advantage.

Now get out there and do your job.  Let's win this one and go home.

text_zh:
地点：厄立特里亚，萨哈尔省

这里是非洲之角，先生们。希望你们会喜欢，因为我们要在这里待上一阵子。

目前的局势是：我们作为多国部队的一部分进入，应厄立特里亚政府的要求展开行动。我们的老朋友俄罗斯人为他们的政变筹措资金的方式之一，就是低价倾销剩余武器。埃塞俄比亚军中以伍德上校为首的一派，正是他们最好的客户之一。拿到武器后，伍德和他的支持者随即动手，推翻了合法政府，并朝红海海岸推进。目前他们控制着马萨瓦以南的所有水域，还在一路向北，吞并厄立特里亚军队的地盘。我们就是来管管这件事的。

为了尽量保住当地的基础设施，厄立特里亚政府还要求我们尽可能保护当地建筑。这意味着你们的小队会有很多活干。第一项任务，是夺取马萨瓦以北海滩上的一座无线电发射塔。海滩守备薄弱，但电台所在崖壁的接近路线就另当别论了。先清空海滩，再向上攻到高地，拿下发射塔。得手后，清掉守卫海滩通道的机枪巢。可以的话，把这片区域的敌对势力全部清除。跟随你们进场的部队会感谢你们的。
text_en:
Location: Samhar Awraja, Eritrea

This is the Horn of Africa, gentlemen. I hope you like it, because we're going to be here a while.

This is our situation: We're going in as part of a multinational force operating at the request of the Eritrean government. It seems that one of the ways our friends back in Russia bankrolled their coup was selling surplus weapons, cheap. A faction of the Ethiopian military led by a certain Col. Tesfaye Wolde was one of their best customers. Once they got their arms, Wolde and his supporters made their move, overthrowing the legitimate government and then making a push for the Red Sea coast. Right now they own everything on the water south of Massawa, and they're rolling up the Eritrean army as they head north. We're here to do something about that.

In order to leave some kind of infrastructure intact, the Eritrean government has also requested that we try to preserve as much of the local architecture as possible. That  means that your unit is going to be getting a lot of work. Your first mission is to secure a radio transmitter on the beach north of Massawa. The beach is guarded lightly, but the approach up the bluffs that the station's sitting on is another story. Clear the beach first, then work your way up to the heights and take that transmitter. Once that's in hand, clear out the machine gun nests guarding the beach approaches. If you can, clear the area of all hostiles. The troops following you will appreciate it.

text_zh:
地点：厄立特里亚，马萨瓦

看来我们接了个急活。我们向马萨瓦市区的推进很顺利，但埃塞俄比亚军正在后撤中实行焦土政策。他们最新的目标是城外的一座炼油厂，厄立特里亚急需它完好无损。侦察报告称，埃塞俄比亚人已经推平了一部分，正在安装炸药，准备毁掉其余部分。我们绝不能让这事发生。

你们将从南面接近炼油厂。突入，守住，然后解决安放炸药的小队。我们还听说，当初入侵者以为自己能接管炼油厂，曾扣压了部分厂方技术人员充当人质。找到仍被扣押的幸存者，沿连接厂区和铁路干线的铁轨线把他们送出去。同样，可以的话就把场内敌军全部消灭。但救人和保厂更重要。
text_en:
Location: Massawa, Eritrea

It looks like we have a rush job on our hands. We're making good progress in the push for Massawa itself, but the Ethiopian forces have adopted a scorched-earth policy as they fall back. Their latest target is the refinery complex just outside the city, one which Eritrea desperately needs intact. Recon reports that the Ethiopians have already leveled part of it, however, and they're in the process of planting the charges that will destroy the rest. We can't allow that to happen.

You'll be approaching the refinery from the south. Move in, secure it, and deal with the squad planting the demo charges. We've also heard that some members of the refinery staff were taken hostage, back when the invaders thought they were going to be operating the refinery themselves and needed expertise on hand. Find the survivors still being held hostage and extract them along the rail line that links the complex to the main track grid. Again, if you can, eliminate all of the enemy forces on site. However, rescuing the hostages and the refinery is more important.

text_zh:
地点：厄立特里亚，德纳基尔省南部

敌军的补给大部分靠铁路运送。我们的下一个目标，就是切断这条补给线。第一步，是夺取通往吉布提的铁路干线上的一座调度场。按惯例直接叫空中打击就行，但他们在调度场上方的高地上架设了一枚防空导弹，得先端掉它才能放我们的空中力量进场。卫星侦察还显示，导弹阵地附近有一处帐篷营地，你们也要把它清掉，否则无论打导弹还是打调度场都会很麻烦。

最后的目标是调度场大楼。尽快拿下它：我们相信里面有关于埃塞俄比亚部队补给线的重要情报。他们一旦察觉，一定会设法毁掉它。
text_en:
Location: Southern Denakil Awraja, Eritrea

The invasion force is bringing in most of its supplies by rail. Our next goal is to put a stop to that. The first step is going to be seizing a depot along the main rail line that runs to Djibouti. Normally we'd just take it out with air strikes, but they've parked a SAM launcher on the heights above the depot, and that needs to be taken out before we can send in the flyboys. We have gotten some satellite reconnaissance that tells us there's a tent encampment near the SAM site. You need to clear that out as well, otherwise taking out either the SAM launcher or the railroad depot is going to be tricky.

The final objective is the depot building. Take it as quickly as possible - we believe that there's important intel in there relating to the supply lines for the Ethiopian troops. They're sure to try to destroy it once they realize what's going on.

text_zh:
地点：埃塞俄比亚，提格雷州

这次任务有点特别，先生们。我们要去做一件善事。大家也许知道，亚的斯亚贝巴的政变正好赶上了他们二十年来最严重的旱灾。画面传不回国内，但可以肯定，边境两侧的内陆有大量挨饿的人。更糟的是，与新政府有勾结的当地军阀开始劫持救援卡车，抢走或毁掉车上的物资。

于是，国际救援机构联盟请求军方为开往难民营的补给车队护航。头一趟由你们来。你们将护送一支四辆卡车的小型车队，前往德纳基尔沙漠西缘附近的一座难民营，那片地方严格说已经越过埃塞俄比亚边境。此外，我们还发现一伙埃塞俄比亚非正规武装就守在通往难民营的必经路线上。他们多半会设法瘫痪卡车、抢走物资。阻止他们就是你们的任务。要是能让他们以后再也不敢骚扰别人，那就是加分项。

车队要走的路线穿过一条干涸的老河床，那是绝佳的伏击点。务必让所有卡车完好无损地通过。占领高地，干掉那些守着物资准备下手的火箭筒巡逻队。能把敌军全部歼灭当然更好，但最重要的是让车队完好地穿过河床。
text_en:
Location: Tigray Kilil, Ethiopia

This one's a little different, gentlemen. We've been tapped to do a good deed. As you may know, the coup in Addis Ababa coincided with the worst droughts they've had in twenty years. The pictures aren't making the news back home, but rest assured that there are a lot of starving people in the interior, on both sides of the border. Making it worse, local warlords with ties to the new government have taken to hijacking the relief trucks and stealing or destroying their contents.

As a result, a coalition of international relief agencies has asked for military escorts for supply caravans heading for the refugee camps.  You'll be handling the first run.  You'll be escorting a small convoy of four trucks to the refugee camp near the western edge of the Denakil desert - territory that's technically across the Ethiopian border. Furthermore, we've spotted a band of Ethiopian irregulars sitting across the logical route to the camp. They're most likely going to try to disable the trucks and make off with the supplies. Preventing that is your mission. Making sure they don't ever bother anyone else would be a bonus.

The route the convoy will be taking moves through an old riverbed, a perfect ambush point. Make sure all of the trucks make it through in one piece. Get up to the high ground and take out any of the patrols with rocket launchers who are waiting to poach those supplies. If you can wipe out the entire enemy force, so much the better, but the most important thing is to get those trucks through the riverbed in one piece.

text_zh:
地点：埃塞俄比亚，德纳基尔沙漠

我们手上有个微妙的情况。官方口径是：华盛顿让SR-71退役后，我们就没有高速载人侦察机了。而非官方的说法是，它叫曙光，其中一架刚刚坠毁在德纳基尔深处。我们必须赶在当地人拿到残骸之前毁掉它。我们最不需要的，就是我们绝密飞机的残骸出现在国际黑市上，还是由伍德上校来敲槌。

好消息是，这片地区直到最近一直被沙暴笼罩。也就是说，附近的埃塞俄比亚部队还来不及打捞残骸。我们最乐观的估计是，曙光还剩下三大块，散落在一条干涸的河床上。找到它们，在每一块上安放炸药。

你们还应顺手端掉附近的埃塞俄比亚前哨。我们估计他们还没捞到什么，但查证一下总没坏处。拿下阵地，然后离开。回到突入区等待接运。只要天气保持晴朗，直升机很快就到。

这一带还有一座小型补给站。风险不大就顺手拿下。但要当心：敌军轻型装甲已在附近被发现。它被沙暴困住了，可现在天气放晴，你们很可能会碰上它，而且很快。
text_en:
Location: Denakil Desert, Ethiopia

We have a potentially delicate situation on our hands.  Officially, once Washington shut down the SR-71, we haven't had a high-speed manned reconnaissance aircraft.  Unofficially, it's called Aurora and one just went down deep in the heart of the Denakil.  We need to destroy the wreckage before the locals get their hands on it.  The last thing we need is for whatever's left of our classified aircraft to go on the international auction block, with Col. Wolde banging the gavel.

The good news is that the region's been blanketed under a sandstorm until recently.  That means that the Ethiopian troops in the area haven't had a chance to salvage the wreckage.  Our best estimate is that there are three significant chunks of the Aurora left, scattered along the length of a dry riverbed.  Find them and plant charges on each.

You'll also want to take out the Ethiopian outpost nearby.  We don't think that they've managed to salvage anything, but it never hurts to be sure.  Take the site and then get out of there.  Return to your insertion zone for pickup.  Assuming the weather stays clear, the choppers will be there in a hurry.

There's also a small supply dump in the area.  If you can take it without too much risk, do it.  Be warned, though -- enemy light armor's been spotted in the area.  It's been immobilized by the storm, but now that the weather's cleared you're likely to run into it, and sooner rather than later.

你们还应顺手端掉附近的埃塞俄比亚前哨。我们估计他们还没捞到什么，但查证一下总没坏处。拿下阵地，然后离开。回到突入区等待接运。只要天气保持晴朗，直升机很快就到。

这一带还有一座小型补给站。风险不大就顺手拿下。但要当心：敌军轻型装甲已在附近被发现。它被沙暴困住了，可现在天气放晴，你们很可能会碰上它，而且很快。

text_zh:
地点：厄立特里亚，阿迪凯伊

先生们，让我介绍一下埃巴塔。他是当地一名地方豪强，过去盘踞在维克罗以东一带。他还是伍德上校的老朋友，如今在阿迪凯伊城外的一座荒村里安了家。他和他的部下就是你们的目标。

随着埃塞俄比亚部队后撤，他们留下了些东西：地雷。它们不仅拖慢我们的推进，而且我们几乎不可能把雷全找出来排掉，这意味着今后多年，当地人都要面对这些不速之祸。

头等大事是取回正在布设的雷区分布图。埃巴塔负责这一段工程，图纸就放在他设于镇东北一条盒状山谷里的前线指挥部。镇子另一头是一家修车废料场，里面的车辆也全部要毁掉。然后才是大奖：埃巴塔本人。

如果埃巴塔不在前线指挥部，他就在镇外一座小山上的房子里，那是他强占的。他在那里挖了堑壕固守，部队散布在废墟各处。你们要打进去，把他拖出来。得手后，前往接送点，位置在镇南的山脊上。
text_en:
Location: Adi K'eyih, Eritrea

Gentlemen, let me introduce you to Ashenafi Abate. He's a local strongman who used to be based out of the area east of Wik'ro. However, he's also an old friend of Col. Wolde's, and has now set up residence in a ghost town outside of Adi K'eyih. He and his command are your target.

As the Ethiopian troops fall back, they're leaving something behind: land mines. Not only do they slow our advance, it's highly unlikely that we're going to find and detonate them all, and that means they're going to be providing unpleasant surprises for the local populace for years to come.

Your first priority is to recover the maps of the minefields that are being laid. Abate's in charge of this section of the project, and he's keeping them in his field HQ in a box canyon northeast of the town. On the opposite end of town is a motor pool tucked into a junkyard. You'll want to disable all of the vehicles there as well.  Then you get to go after the big prize: Abate himself.

If Abate's not in the field HQ, he'll be in a house he's commandeered, on a hill just outside of what's left of the town. He's dug in there, with a trench network defending it, and his troops are positioned all through the wreckage. You're going to go in there and drag him out. Once you've got Abate in hand, head for the pickup point. It's located in the ridges to the south of town.

地点：厄立特里亚，阿卡勒古扎伊省

我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。好消息是，我们从阿斯马拉通往阿迪格拉特的一条南北干道上，重新集结起一支厄立特里亚步兵纵队正在北上。坏消息是，这一地区的埃塞俄比亚指挥官比你那位朋友埃巴塔能干得多，已经在他们的路线上备好了一份不速之礼。他在路上设了路障，部队在两侧挖壕固守，还在路西高地上占了一个设防阵地。更麻烦的是，他就把部队扎在一座战地医院旁边，也就是说，这次没有空中支援。我们最不需要的，就是各大新闻台反复播放我们误炸医院的画面。

你们必须拿下那个路障。为此要清掉通道两侧的堑壕，再干掉高地上的营地。如果他们有车辆支援，一并解决。然后沿路向西推进。散兵不用管，跟在你们后面的部队会负责扫尾。
text_en:
Location: Akale Guzay Awraja, Eritrea

I have some good news and some bad news. The good news is that we have a re-formed column of Eritrean infantry advancing along one of the major north-south roads from Asmara to Adigrat. The bad news is that the Ethiopian commander in the region is a damn sight more efficient than your friend Abate and has prepared an unpleasant surprise along their route. He's got a roadblock thrown up across the route, with his troops dug in on both sides of it and holding a fortified position on the heights west of the road. Furthermore, he's parked his men right next to a field hospital, which means you'll be doing this without air support. The last thing we need is all the cable news networks showing endless re-runs of us accidentally blowing a hospital to smithereens.

You need to take that roadblock. To do that, you're going to need to clear out the trenches on either side of the road leading up the obstruction, and take out the encampment on the heights as well. If they've got any vehicle support, neutralize it. Then proceed along the road to the west. Don't worry about stragglers. The troops coming in behind you will handle the mop-up work.

text_zh:
地点：厄立特里亚，阿迪夸拉附近，梅雷布河渡口

先生们，就是这里了。我们已经把埃塞俄比亚部队赶回边境对面，并和流亡中的合法政府取得了联系。走运的话，他们很快就能复职，我们也能收尾了。

只剩最后一件事：伍德上校。伍德认定，挽回当前局面的最好办法，就是带上他剩下的全部装甲亲自出战，为部队打气。这一招高明与否留给你们评价，但此人的胆量无可指摘。

无论如何，他所在的纵队正在向北开进。我们预计它将在大约11点抵达梅雷布河上的一座桥，而你们要在那里恭候。

纵队要走的大桥横跨一处瀑布群旁的峡谷。你们从下游进入，附近是一片宽阔的浅滩，有几座海关建筑看守。你们要立刻守住渡口，然后进入位置打击坦克。那座桥大概是把他们堵死的好地方，而在装甲赶到之前，务必先解决据守桥头堡的步兵。否则他们会合流，你们就有大麻烦了。还有一件事：他们最后一枚防空导弹也在守桥，位置在渡口以西、坦克必经的路线上。把它端掉，我们就能一劳永逸地结束这一切。
text_en:
Location: Mereb Wenz crossing, near Adi Kwala, Eritrea

This, gentlemen, is it. We've pushed the Ethiopian forces back across the border, and we've been in contact with the legitimate government in exile. With any luck, they'll be back in power shortly, and we can wrap this up.

There's just one detail left to take care of: Colonel Tesfaye Wolde. Wolde has decided that the best way to salvage the current situation is to ride out with whatever armor he's got left in an effort to rally the troops personally. I'll leave the wisdom of that particular approach for you to judge, but you can't fault the man's guts.

In any case, the column he's riding with is moving north. We're expecting it to hit a bridge over the Mereb Wenz at approximately 1100 hours, and you're going to be there to greet it.

The column will be moving over a bridge that crosses a gorge near a series of waterfalls. You'll be going in downstream, near a broad, shallow ford guarded by a few customs buildings. You'll want to secure that crossing immediately, then move into position to take out the tanks. The bridge is probably the best place to bottle them up, and you'll definitely want to take out the infantry holding it before the armor gets there. If not, they'll link up and you'll be in a world of hurt. One more thing: The last of their SAM launchers is guarding the bridge as well. It's positioned to the west of the crossing, along the route the tanks are going to follow. Take it out and we can end this once and for all.

text_zh:
欢迎参加第一次战术演习。本次任务的目标是消灭对方部队。

该区域有敌军巡逻队。查看指挥地图，可以看到情报已经为你们和你的小队标出了几个合适的射击位置。

另外，我们强烈建议使用总部预先选定的队伍和武器配置，那是完成任务的最好方案。

试用小队里的每一种枪械，体会各自的用法。还有一些固定重机枪可供使用。
text_en:
Welcome to your first tactical exercise.  During this mission, your objective is to eliminate the opposing force.

There are enemy patrols in the area.  If you check the command map, you will see that intel has marked some good fire positions for you and your team to engage them from.

Also, we strongly recommend you use the team and weapon loadout that have been pre-selected by HQ.  It is the best setup to do the job.

Try out each of the different firearms available in your teams to get a feel for how each one operates.  There are stationary heavy machineguns available to you as well.

text_en:
Here's the situation, Intel has discovered that one of our downed airmen was being transported in a train to a location for interrogation.  Thanks to some well-placed explosives, the train has been derailed.

Your job is to get in there and rescue our pilot.

Get to the flyboy quickly with one team and set up a good cover position with the other.  We understand there are only a few enemy soldiers with the prisoner, but reinforcements will arrive soon.

Once you have the pilot with you, get to the extraction zone as quickly as possible.

text_en:
This is your chance to really do some damage.  Intel reports that a shipment of new torpedoes has just arrived at an enemy naval base.

Your mission is to infiltrate a warehouse and plant demo charges there.

Once you have placed the charges, return to the extraction zone as quickly as possible. The demolition charges will explode after you have left the area, but alerted enemies will close on your position quickly.
